statements.subject: connection
statements.description: Acknowledgements of A-to-B data MAY be piggybacked on data sent by DCCP B, as long as that does not delay the acknowledgement longer than the A-to-B CCID would find acceptable.
actions: piggyback A-to-B acknowledgement onto B-to-A data packet

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: In this case, DCCP B SHOULD send separate DCCP-Data and DCCP-Ack packets, or wait, but not too long, for a smaller datagram.
statements.trigger: piggybacked acknowledgement would cause packet to exceed maximum packet size
actions: OR wait briefly for a smaller datagram to piggyback onto
